name: Ernst Henne
features: fair skin, brown hair, blue eyes, broad friendly face, sturdy build, easy-going expression
bio: Ernst Jakob Henne held the world motorcycle speed record almost continuously from 1929 to 1937, finally leaving it at 279.5 km/h on a streamlined BMW — a mark that stood for fourteen years. He raced cars for BMW and Mercedes-Benz alongside the motorcycles, and lived to 101.
